about: Modwerk source-only silent-pad-trig (Improved Configs) package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/silent-pad-trig.

mods.title: Improved Configs
mods.summary: Four checkboxes: silent pad and TRIG selects, outside and in LIVE RECORDING; MUTE ALL SOUND keeps a muted track silent while trigs record; PAD LEAVES FX lets a pad take you off the FX track to its own page.
mods.description: Four checkboxes: silent pad and TRIG selects, outside and in LIVE RECORDING; MUTE ALL SOUND keeps a muted track silent while trigs record; PAD LEAVES FX lets a pad take you off the FX track to its own page.

mods.on_unit: 0.9.0 ran on an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 in the author's combined build PC01 (RAM-booted), as reported; this package has not run on a unit.
